# Hidden worker, fired from options of oe_y1.1, .5, .10, .12, .13 (CHI), .6 (KOR) and .11 (TIB) with the country var oe_y1_job.
oe_y1.20 = {
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    title = oe_y1.20.t
    trigger = { has_variable = oe_y1_job }
    immediate = {
        if = { limit = { var:oe_y1_job = 11 } every_subject = { limit = { oe_y1_xz_marked = yes } add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_weak_minus } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y1_job = 13 } every_subject = { limit = { oe_y1_xz_marked = yes } add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_weak_plus } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y1_job = 51 } oe_y1_job_depose = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y1_job = 61 } oe_y1_job_lisuo = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y1_job = 101 } oe_y1_job_101 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y1_job = 102 } oe_y1_job_102 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y1_job = 103 } oe_y1_job_103 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y1_job = 111 } oe_y1_job_111 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y1_job = 112 } oe_y1_job_112 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y1_job = 113 } oe_y1_job_113 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y1_job = 121 } oe_y1_job_121 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y1_job = 122 } oe_y1_job_122 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y1_job = 131 } oe_y1_job_131 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y1_job = 132 } oe_y1_job_132 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y1_job = 133 } oe_y1_job_133 = yes }
        remove_variable = oe_y1_job
    }
}

# TEST ONLY. The King of Goryeo dies now (tests event .3; the next month records the change of king).
oe_y1.21 = {
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    title = oe_y1.21.t
    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { has_ruler = yes } }
            c:KOR = { ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_y1_test_king } }
            kill_character_silently = scope:oe_y1_test_king
            debug_log = "oe_y1 TEST: the King of Goryeo died"
        }
    }
}

# TEST ONLY. Like vanilla red_turban_rebellions.44's option: the Yuan lets go of every subject whose capital lies in
# tibet_region (no has_fired_unique_event, so the markers end with reason 1).
oe_y1.22 = {
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    title = oe_y1.22.t
    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:CHI }
            region:tibet_region = {
                every_country_with_capital_in_geography = {
                    limit = { is_subject_of = c:CHI }
                    c:CHI = { cancel_subject = prev }
                }
            }
            debug_log = "oe_y1 TEST: the Yuan released its Tibetan subjects"
        }
    }
}

# TEST ONLY. The Yuan lets go of Goryeo (tests the end of the Zhengdong marker, reason 3).
oe_y1.23 = {
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    title = oe_y1.23.t
    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:CHI country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { is_subject_of = c:CHI } }
            c:CHI = { cancel_subject = c:KOR }
            debug_log = "oe_y1 TEST: the Yuan released Goryeo"
        }
    }
}
